alt: The step editor showing a script, a file transfer, and a call-snippet step in one ordered sequence
caption: A snippet is an ordered sequence of steps. Mix script blocks, file transfers, and calls to other snippets; drag to reorder.

alt: First-run screen: Get started, secured by the OS keychain with no password needed
caption: On first run, choose how to protect your vault. “Get started” stores the encryption key in your OS keychain — no master password, no account.

alt: The Members tab of a team vault: the owner and one member, each with a role badge
caption: The Members tab lists everyone with access to the team vault and their role. Invite by email, filter by role, and manage seats from here.

alt: The Roles panel: members with role badges on the left, a built-in role's permission matrix expanded on the right
caption: Every member gets a role. Built-in roles (Owner, Manager, Editor, Member, Connect-Only) each grant a fixed set of permissions — expand one to see exactly what it allows.

alt: The custom role builder with per-resource, per-action permission checkboxes
caption: Business plans add a role builder. Give a role a name and colour, then mix and match granular permissions — here a Deploy role that can view secrets and connect, but not copy secrets.

alt: A team vault selected in the sidebar, showing its shared hosts and the two team members
caption: A team vault sits alongside your Personal vault in the sidebar. Everything inside — hosts, keys, snippets — is shared with the team and end-to-end encrypted for every member.

alt: The home page listing a Personal vault and an Acme Team vault with their hosts
caption: Vaults keep contexts separate. Your Personal vault is private to you; a Team vault is shared with — and end-to-end encrypted for — everyone you invite.

alt: The team Logs tab: a timeline of who did what, with filters by member, event type, and date range
caption: Every team action is recorded — who invited whom, who created or edited a host, and when. Filter by member, event type, or date range, and export for compliance.

alt: The Sync settings panel: cloud sync active with a timestamp, plus per-type sync toggles
caption: Real-time cloud sync keeps every signed-in device in step. The relay only ever sees ciphertext — and you choose exactly which object types sync.

match: multiplayer bar in a shared session
alt: A shared terminal: the sharing bar shows the host and a joined participant, with a Stop control
caption: Share a live terminal with your team. Everyone in the session shows up in the bar — you keep control until you hand it off, and can stop sharing at any time.

alt: A guest watching a shared terminal in real time, with Request Control and Leave in the multiplayer bar
caption: Guests watch the session live as it happens. Any guest can request control; the host grants or revokes it, and either side can leave whenever.

alt: The launch unlock screen prompting for the master password, with an Unlock button
caption: With a master password, Voltius asks for your passphrase at every launch before decrypting the vault. There's no recovery — the key is derived from your password, never stored.
